notes: All arithmetic wraps modulo 2^64; zero iterations return seed without data access.
Work counts one semantic update or load per iteration, not executed instructions. Actual loop work determines the returned state.
Unsigned division by 10 versus high unsigned product by 0xcccccccccccccccd shifted right by 3, exact over all uint64 inputs.
Both variants initialize divisor, reciprocal and salt before the loop; ADD does not set flags.
Data and mask are unused. Constant setup is outside the loop; MCA assumes constants already materialized.
